display.purpose: Headings; same Comme family, hierarchy by size and weight only, tight (1.25) line-height.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Coral CTA button; the only saturated element on most screens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #ee5253; color: #fdfbfb; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms, opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0.1rem solid oklch(76.8% 0.233 130.85); outline-offset: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet warm-stone button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #f5f5f4; color: #1c1917; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 0.1rem solid oklch(76.8% 0.233 130.85); outline-offset: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent button with hairline border; fills with warm stone on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: #1d0303; border: 1px solid #f5f5f4; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f5f5f4; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 0.1rem solid oklch(76.8% 0.233 130.85); outline-offset: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Filled Card
components.description: Default content card: white surface, whisper shadow, medium radius.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 0.5rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); padding: 1.5rem; color: #1d0303; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card p { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field: paper fill, hairline stone border, lime focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fdfbfb; border: 1px solid #f5f5f4; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; color: #1d0303; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 0.1rem solid oklch(76.8% 0.233 130.85); outline-offset: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Coral Bar Link
components.description: The signature link treatment: a 0.25rem coral bottom bar grows to full height on hover while the text flips to the background color. Light mode blends the bar over the glyphs with color-dodge; dark mode renders it as solid coral beneath the text instead (normal blend, z-index -1, isolated link) because the dodge would blow out to neon red.
components.css: .ds-link { position: relative; isolation: isolate; color: #ee5253; text-decoration: none; transition: color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.690, 0.420, 0.180, 0.985); } .ds-link::after { content: ""; mix-blend-mode: color-dodge; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 0.25rem; background: #ee5253; border-radius: 0.25rem; z-index: 1; transition: height 100ms cubic-bezier(0.690, 0.420, 0.180, 0.985); } .ds-link:hover { color: #fdfbfb; } .ds-link:hover::after { height: 100%; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-link::after { mix-blend-mode: normal; z-index: -1; } }

narrative.northStar: A postcard from a friend who lives there
narrative.overview: Everything on Šrilanka.lv reads like a personal message from one real person, not a travel brand. The visual system supports that: a warm near-white paper ground, espresso-dark ink with a faint red undertone, and a single coral accent that carries every action and link. Real photography from Sri Lanka does the atmospheric work; the UI itself stays quiet, flat, and warm so the photos and the host's voice lead. The system is theme-paired: a light theme (approved, canonical) and a dark theme driven by the same 10-slot color contract (background, foreground, primary, primaryForeground, secondary, secondaryForeground, accent, accentForeground, error, errorForeground) defined once in src/shared/styles/tokens/colors.ts and applied via vanilla-extract themes. There are no per-component dark overrides; the contract is the single source of truth.
keyCharacteristics: One coral accent (#ee5253), identical in both themes
Warm neutrals everywhere; nothing pure black, nothing cool-toned
Flat surfaces, whisper-quiet shadows, hairline dividers via color-mix
Real photos with dark scrims for text legibility; UI recedes behind them

rules.name: The One Coral Rule
rules.body: Coral #ee5253 is the only saturated UI color and does not change between themes. No second accent is ever introduced.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries a trace of warmth (red-to-stone hues, 17-56°); pure #000, pure grays, and cool/blue tints are off-brand.

rules.name: The Whisper Shadow Rule
rules.body: All shadows stay at 5% alpha. If an element needs more separation, change its surface color, not its shadow.

rules.name: The Coral Bar Rule
rules.body: Every content link carries a coral bottom bar (0.25rem) that grows to full height on hover while the text flips to the background color. In light mode the bar sits over the glyphs with mix-blend-mode: color-dodge; in dark mode the dodge would blow out to neon red, so the bar renders as solid coral beneath the text (darkThemeSelector override in global.css.ts: normal blend, z-index -1, isolated link).

dos: Do keep coral #ee5253 as the only saturated color in both themes.
Do keep every neutral warm (hue 17-56°); tint, never pure black or white surfaces (the sole exception is the light filled card, which is #fff by design).
Do create separation with surface steps and 10% color-mix hairlines.
Do put text over photos only with a black gradient scrim.
donts: Don't introduce cool/blue-tinted neutrals; they fight the brand's warmth.
Don't add per-component dark-mode color overrides; all theme colors flow through the 10-slot contract in tokens/colors.ts.
Don't author or alter Latvian copy as part of design work; copy is owned by the host.
